summary: app-systems pre-merge security review (areas 1-6 of security.md): no merge blockers. Decision 382 (os/ write hole) still closed; FilePath canonicalization regression still closed; terminal sandbox fails closed on non-Linux / Landlock<3; signing pipeline + nonce replay sound; [Sensitive] does not cross Out wire; settings store partitions per actor via '<actor>!<path>' key with hard-coded closed-set actor names. Four non-blocking findings (all carry): F1 live-signature-no-expiry NRE in VerifyAsync step 6; F2 case-sensitivity split between GlobMatches and Places; F3 standing in-memory grants dedup only by Path (invariant depends on ctor call order); F4 Landlock sandbox doesn't scope network (documented in the Sandbox.cs doc comment itself). Semgrep: 24 hits, all baseline-accounted (22 serializer-hygiene audit list, 1 gated Assembly.LoadFrom, 1 Display.Gate false positive).

findings.title: VerifyAsync NRE on live signature with no Expires
findings.summary: Step 6 (nonce record) dereferences signature.Expires!.Value for Origin.Live signatures. SignAsync accepts Expires==null and produces exactly such signatures. Step 1 (expiry) returns false when Expires is null, so step 6 is reached. Step 5's try/catch does not cover step 6, so an NRE escapes. Fails safe (no false 'verified: true'), but SignAsync and VerifyAsync disagree on whether live signatures may have no expiry.
findings.fix_direction: Either refuse Expires==null in SignAsync on live, or skip step 6's nonce record when Expires is null, or require Expires for live and have step 1 refuse the no-expires case explicitly.

findings.title: Case-sensitivity split between GlobMatches and Places
findings.summary: The standing /os/** grant uses Match.glob, compiled by GlobMatches to a case-sensitive regex. Places (PLang/app/type/item/path/file/this.Validate.cs:80-83) uses StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase for its os/ overlay match. On case-insensitive filesystems the two sides can in principle diverge; today no path producer actually mismatches casing, so the finding is latent.
findings.fix_direction: Honour the platform's path comparison in GlobMatches for file-scheme paths (RegexOptions.IgnoreCase under RootComparison == OrdinalIgnoreCase).

findings.title: Standing in-memory grants deduped only by Path
findings.summary: The in-memory grant store keys standing grants by Path only; a later Stand(verbs...) replaces the earlier verb set. System actor rights depend on the base ctor's read+execute Stand being overwritten by actor/list/this.cs:15-17's wider Stand. Nothing in the type system enforces the call order.
findings.fix_direction: Make System's extended rights explicit (e.g. a protected Baseline() virtual the actor ctor calls, overridden on System) rather than relying on a later Stand overwrite.

findings.title: Terminal sandbox does not scope the network
findings.summary: Landlock 3 does not scope the network namespace; sandboxed child processes can reach any TCP/UDP endpoint. The code's own XML doc states this openly. Linux 6.12 extends Landlock to network; WSL 6.6 does not have it. Carried from the architect's own disclosure to make it audit-visible.
findings.fix_direction: Track as a known Landlock-3 limitation. Revisit when PLang's minimum kernel bumps to 6.12.
